_comment: Declarative input list for scripts/attestation-build.sh. Per-category slots map to the artifact path the producing bead must emit. The build script hashes each populated path and assembles a bundle. A null path is allowed only when deferred_to_bead and deferred_reason identify the bead that must publish the missing artifact; release builds can still fail deferred slots with --strict-deferred.

slots.description: Headline-claim manifest + 5 must-prove benches (G3).

Differential bench matrix vs WezTerm/Zellij/Ghostty (G3). Recovery artifact published by ft-e87u6.9 (closed); substrate provenance traces to the ft-t101b deterministic competitor-bench fixture under ft-syqcz.5. Producer attribution corrected from the original null-slot misattribution to ft-syqcz.4 per the artifact's recommended_produced_by_bead field.

Lindley/min-plus algebra bounds derived from latency_stages.rs (G3). Substrate-pass artifact via crates/frankenterm-core/examples/lindley_bounds_build.rs (br-ft-43x69 substrate-pass; ft-syqcz.5 sibling); the wired-pass cont-bead swaps the hard-coded per-stage rates for live latency_stages.rs telemetry reads + bench-driven empirical_p99_ms + sigstore signing.

ratatui<->ftui differential render parity report (G5). Recovery artifact published by ft-e87u6.10 (closed) backfilling the original ft-35yac.2 producer slot. The GPU adjunct stays in the sibling slot for ft-35yac.1.2.

Headless GPU-renderer visual parity contract for the G5 render-parity category. Runtime runs emit target/gpu-regression/<runner>/render-parity-gpu.json beside summary.json; the full ratatui<->ftui byte-level report remains ft-35yac.2.

Continuous FrankenTerm-vs-upstream-WezTerm render differential slot. The checked-in artifact records the allowlist gate and current adapter blocker; production evidence requires a workflow run with frames_compared_total > 0 and novel_divergence_count == 0.

Persistent-homology glyph topology adjunct for the G5 render-parity category. The artifact occupies the release-bundle tui/topology-parity.json slot while remaining under the existing tui/render-parity schema category; production evidence requires paired oracle/subject glyph bitmap runs for the terminal-conformance fixtures.
Passive-watch read-only fuzz proof (G9). Recovery artifact published by ft-e87u6.11 (closed) backfilling the original ft-x0666.1 producer slot.
Redactor recall/precision matrix vs gitleaks/trufflehog corpora (G10).
Distributed wire-protocol threat model + diff fuzz (G11).
Loom proof for runtime_async primitives (G8).
Mazurkiewicz cancel-trace equivalence classes for runtime_async primitive cancellation semantics (G21).
RuntimeProof sealed trait + tokio type-level seal (G1). Recovery artifact published by ft-e87u6.13 (closed) backfilling the original ft-i2eni.1 producer slot.

Tokio-eradication doctrine status for the G1 runtime-proof category: direct-dependency ban, supported-path #[tokio::test] classification, asupersync-test-only lint, LabRuntime/asupersync_test substrate, and CI wiring.

Robot/MCP/CLI control-plane golden matrix for schema-backed envelopes, live profile/fleet mutation receipts, and backend-unavailable/policy/approval failure contracts (G2; originally introduced under ft-q5njp).
TX kill-switch formal-method attestation: TLA+ TLC pass, Rust BFS state-space proof, and CI million-schedule random invariant lane.
Auto-stamped README/AGENTS module/crate/test counts (G6).

Vendored fork provenance manifest (G15). Generated by scripts/regen-provenance.py; checked-in copy serves as the attestation source. The CI guard scripts/check-provenance.sh refuses a stale manifest, so the bundle hash always reflects HEAD.

Cx-propagation burndown snapshot (G14.2). Per-bucket coverage of asupersync Cx threading across the codebase. The verifier asserts totals.uncovered_sites == 0 — a release with any uncovered cancellation site fails the gate.

Per-(corpus, packer) atlas-packing efficiency report. Generated by `cargo run --release -p frankenterm-core --example atlas_packing_attestation` against the four glyph corpora (Latin, CJK, Nerd Font, emoji) at 2048² with all three packers (Shelf, Skyline, MaximalRectangles). Re-run before each release; this file is sha256-hashed into the per-release bundle. Not in required_categories yet — the attestation surface is opt-in until ft-gtcm9.{2,3} land the GUI wiring + ft doctor surface that consume the underlying packer choice.
